comment: Existing frameworks on aspects of digital health already operate in various areas of the world, but the document does not articulate how DPI-H aligns with the European regulatory environment, particularly the GDPR and the European Health Data Space (EHDS), where consent, data minimisation and cross-border interoperability are legally defined.

anchor.note: about the whole document, by a placement agent reading the comment against the text (medium): Requests GDPR/EHDS alignment generally; cited pages (119-121, App. C) do not match the subject.
